Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes This PR lets sessions run directly in existing folders on explicitly selected paired devices. **Example:** Start a session on paired-runner in the existing non-Git folder /srv/existing project. - **Before:** Device-hosted sessions use an OpenClaw-managed workspace rather than that existing device folder. - **After:** The worker runs in /srv/existing project, stays bound to paired-runner, and leaves the folder intact when the session is deleted. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** | Useful, coherent feature work with shipped-path behavior, authority, and upgrade evidence and no identified actionable defect; pending CI remains a landing gate. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** | Sufficient (live_output): Supplied real Gateway and paired-node evidence exercises creation, explicit dispatch, hosted execution, restart recovery, attachment refusal, folder preservation, scope denial, and caller/device revocation before worker execution; inspected screenshots cover desktop and mobile presentation. | | **Patch quality** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Feature · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Users cannot run a complete hosted session directly in an existing non-Git folder on their paired device. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored direction supplies a concrete device workflow, reuses existing execution owners, and explicitly documents its consent and lifecycle tradeoffs. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** Keep open: this maintainer-authored PR adds a useful capability absent from current main, and no definite introduced defect was found; current-head CI remains pending. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `364a0000a69b09b9a51defa90e69cababc077829` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None.
Agent review details ### How this fits together The Control UI submits a device and folder to Gateway session creation; the paired node validates its local folder policy, and existing placement and worker lifecycle owners execute turns without transferring the folder. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Control UI] --> B[Gateway session creation] B --> C[Session entry] B --> D[Paired node folder validation] C --> E[Worker placement] E --> F[Node worker supervisor] F --> G[Existing user folder] F --> H[Private worker HOME] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Land the device-bound workspace mode through the existing worker owners while preserving node-local consent and user-folder lifecycle guarantees. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? This is a feature addition: current-main source lacks the new creation parameter, and supplied live evidence exercises the proposed device-folder flow. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The implementation fits the existing placement and worker lifecycle owners and keeps user-owned folders outside Gateway transfer and reconciliation. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [f4f0255bc773](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f4f0255bc773d767c5ddc43a15e20202c8e33065). ### Provenance checked - `Paired-worker workspace transport` keeps the original intent (438d0358857ba4ab15a23a890862cffc4cdbb7e1: The original paired-worker launch implementation deliberately used node-owned workspaces; subsequent transfer work supported Gateway-owned inputs and reconciliation.) - `Worker lifetime and teardown` keeps the original intent (e4d602c6f374fd2e325016e6758aee3bc3d5eec0: Existing lifecycle owners preserve background processes and retain exact environment cleanup responsibility; this PR adds folder-specific cleanup without replacing those owners.) - `New Session picker and retry state` keeps the original intent (bcafd72f610e6ceb3e97edac7a183abd9808ac41: Picker changes preserve submitted selections, accepted-session ownership, and concurrent preferences; device-folder recovery likewise retains its frozen request.) ### Testing Proof path: shipped entry point. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Pinned introduction and current-main boundary:** The pinned base-to-head diff adds deviceFolder to sessions.create; the fetched main schema still has no such field. GitHub confirms the reviewed head is open, non-draft, and mergeable. ([`packages/gateway-protocol/src/schema/sessions-create.ts:104`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/364a0000a69b09b9a51defa90e69cababc077829/packages/gateway-protocol/src/schema/sessions-create.ts#L104), [364a0000a69b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/364a0000a69b09b9a51defa90e69cababc077829)) - **Caller and device authority:** Creation composes current requester authority with the validated device connection before commit; private node dispatch rechecks authorization and pairing immediately before sending the command. ([`src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-create.ts:186`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/364a0000a69b09b9a51defa90e69cababc077829/src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-create.ts#L186), [364a0000a69b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/364a0000a69b09b9a51defa90e69cababc077829)) - **Node-owned folder policy:** The node resolves existing directories, rejects filesystem roots and private-storage overlap, applies configured roots, and checks directory identity again before execution. ([`src/node-host/node-worker-device-folder.ts:87`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/364a0000a69b09b9a51defa90e69cababc077829/src/node-host/node-worker-device-folder.ts#L87), [364a0000a69b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/364a0000a69b09b9a51defa90e69cababc077829)) - **Lifecycle preserves user files:** Device-folder completion and reclaim bypass workspace reconciliation; node retention collects namespaced private HOME rather than the existing user folder. ([`src/gateway/worker-environments/placement-reclaim.ts:127`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/364a0000a69b09b9a51defa90e69cababc077829/src/gateway/worker-environments/placement-reclaim.ts#L127), [364a0000a69b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/364a0000a69b09b9a51defa90e69cababc077829)) - **Supplied behavior and authority proof:** The body and obviyus's discussion record real Gateway/node execution across two Macs, restart recovery, independent file readback, attachment refusal, scope denial, and requester/device revocation with no worker execution or persisted session after rejection. ([364a0000a69b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/364a0000a69b09b9a51defa90e69cababc077829)) - **Visual proof inspected:** Prepared screenshots visibly show the previous workspace choice and the new desktop/mobile device-folder input, including /srv/existing project; these are explicitly mocked-Gateway UI captures. ([`ui/src/pages/new-session/target-controls-view.tsx:327`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/364a0000a69b09b9a51defa90e69cababc077829/ui/src/pages/new-session/target-controls-view.tsx#L327), [364a0000a69b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/364a0000a69b09b9a51defa90e69cababc077829)) Likely related people: - **Peter Steinberger:** Raw commit 438d0358857ba4ab15a23a890862cffc4cdbb7e1 adds src/gateway/worker-environments/node-worker-tunnel.ts:70 relative to its recorded parents. This identifies author metadata, not feature responsibility or a PR merger. (role: source-line author; confidence: high; commits: [438d0358857b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/438d0358857ba4ab15a23a890862cffc4cdbb7e1); files: `src/gateway/worker-environments/node-worker-tunnel.ts`) ### PR surface PR surface statistics unavailable: the file list is incomplete. ### Review metrics | Metric | Value | Why it matters | |---|---|---| | **New configuration option** | 1: nodeHost.workerRuns.folders | Unset permits existing directories, a non-empty list restricts roots, and an empty list disables the capability. | | **Persisted workspace binding** | 1 optional session-entry field; no SQL schema change | deviceFolder retains the canonical device/path binding through reset, recovery, and row publication. | ### Labels Label changes: No label changes. Label justifications: - `P2`: A useful optional device-session capability with a limited, explicitly selected execution surface. - `rating: 🦞 diamond lobster`: Overall readiness is 🦞 diamond lobster; proof is 🦞 diamond lobster and patch quality is 🦞 diamond lobster. - `status: 👀 ready for maintainer look`: ClawSweeper has no concrete contributor-facing blocker left for this PR. - `proof: sufficient`: Contributor real behavior proof is sufficient. ### Rating scale 6/6 🦀 challenger crab · 5/6 🦞 diamond lobster · 4/6 🐚 platinum hermit · 3/6 🦐 gold shrimp · 2/6 🦪 silver shellfish · 1/6 🧂 unranked krab. Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality; ✨ marks media proof (a screenshot, video, or linked artifact) that directly shows the changed behavior. ### Workflow ClawSweeper edits this one comment on every review. Comment `@clawsweeper re-review` for a fresh review only. Repair and merge execution lanes are retired. ### History
Review history (20 earlier review cycles; latest 8 shown) - reviewed 2026-10-13T18:18:44.160Z sha 49a83f285a92cdbb47edf3eaf58a4fdc51d69455 :: needs real behavior proof before merge. :: none - reviewed 2026-10-13T19:45:59.343Z sha 49a83f285a92cdbb47edf3eaf58a4fdc51d69455 :: needs changes before merge. :: none - reviewed 2026-10-13T20:45:42.502Z sha f354d35e4aaf29445e3a4355d0faacac43521ebc :: needs maintainer review before merge. :: none - reviewed 2026-10-13T22:44:40.607Z sha 73b0fc131ca2598b9491197d2697cb8af89551b7 :: needs changes before merge. :: none - reviewed 2026-10-14T00:38:13.510Z sha e7db547529c5740e6ce1bb693344b98f47355fd4 :: needs changes before merge. :: none - reviewed 2026-10-14T00:48:30.838Z sha e7db547529c5740e6ce1bb693344b98f47355fd4 :: needs maintainer review before merge. :: none - reviewed 2026-10-14T01:27:17.253Z sha 12a2d823b06a229facfe2d04e1f23b5f1b6f59b2 :: needs maintainer review before merge. :: none - reviewed 2026-10-14T01:37:41.454Z sha bea786ce92558055494151cbf3979f60a7180805 :: needs maintainer review before merge. :: none

### Review pass and exact-head E2E (head `c413c45`)

**Changes in this pass** (`0973a1e`, then two `main` merges that only regenerated the config baseline):
- Fix: a restored existing-folder create retry was blocked by the live device gate (free slots or current runtime) before its frozen-request recovery branch ran. A pending create can hold the device's only slot, so the retry dead-ended after a reload. The recovery branch now runs first; regression in `submit-gates.test.ts` fails before and passes after.
- One owner for the device-folder command shape: `assertNodeWorkspaceDeviceFolderCommand` in `node-workspace-protocol.ts`, used by ingress parsing and direct node execution.
- Removed the naming-only `src/worker/node-device-folder-protocol.ts` re-export, a duplicated runtime-change unit test (the browser E2E covers it), and unchanged-schema cases from the compat test.
- Docs: the selected folder becomes the session workspace root; deployments that contain `operator.write` with `tools.fs.workspaceOnly` should also set `nodeHost.workerRuns.folders`, and the list is a guardrail for the Gateway's requests, not a boundary against a compromised Gateway.
- Pass delta vs `4cc20ff`: 12 files, +80 / −135.

**Cross-machine E2E (two Macs, exact head on both)**: disposable Gateway on one Mac (tailnet TLS, token auth, QA mock model), session-host node on a second Mac with `folders` unset, target an existing non-Git folder there.
- Pairing over tailnet, node advertises `workerHost.deviceFolders: true`.
- Create + explicit dispatch: `active`, `remoteWorkspaceDir` = the folder on the second Mac.
- Hosted exec wrote `pwd` and `hostname` into the folder; independent readback on the second Mac matched.
- Node restart and an unclean Gateway restart, then a second turn appended to the same file.
- Rejected: `~` (overlaps private storage) and a Gateway-only path that does not exist on the device.
- Reclaim + delete: folder kept, sentinel unchanged, no `.git`, no proof file anywhere in Gateway state.

**Single-host isolated E2E (25 checks, all pass)**: defaults, missing/root/file/relative/private-storage rejections, auto-dispatch rejection, two node restarts, Gateway shutdown with a live tunnel and with a durable attachment but no tunnel (the earlier P1 path: clean shutdown, no closed run-end admission), Gateway restart and resume, symlink escape and outside-root rejection under a root list, `[]` disabling the capability.

**Focused checks**: 7 test files, 108 tests pass; oxfmt/oxlint clean on changed files.

**CI on `c413c45`**: red jobs are `chat.native-runtime-consent.test.ts` (also red on another PR's run), four UI chat E2E files this PR does not touch, and `required-native-same-session.e2e.test.ts`, which passes locally on both this head and its `main` base. Failed jobs re-run once.

Maintainer override: the only red job on head `e7db547529c5740e6ce1bb693344b98f47355fd4` is inherited, not caused by this PR.

- **`checks-node-changed-6`**: `test/e2e/qa-lab/runtime/required-native-same-session.e2e.test.ts` ("settles required native empty workspaces and same-session follow-ups through public RPC").
  - The rerun failure ([job 115603271343](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38484522585/job/115603271343)) has this signature: `REQUIRED-NATIVE-0-A` ends with `status: "error"` and "OpenClaw couldn't finish this reply" after the `sessions.changed-snapshot` → `finishing-ACK-pending-publication` boundaries, then `AssertionError: expected { …(21) } to match object { state: 'completed', …(1) }`.
  - Unrelated PRs fail with the same signature in the same hour, at the same boundaries, with the same assertion: [run 38485714839](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38485714839/job/115599552226) (`dbasync/compatgaps`) and [run 38482622405](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38482622405/job/115589173506) (`dbasync/firstturn3`). [Run 38480051576](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38480051576/job/115580500172) (`pgprep/sql-publication-anchor`) fails the same test on a later turn (`REQUIRED-NATIVE-1-B`).
  - The first-attempt failure on this head was a different symptom (`WorkspaceAccessUnavailableError: Remote workspace skill discovery failed`), so the failure is not deterministic.
  - On this exact head the test passes 2 of 2 times locally. It also passed in hosted CI on the previous head `73b0fc1`, and 3 of 3 times locally on the earlier head `f354d35`.
  - The PR's shared worker changes add branches only for inputs that carry `deviceFolder` (for example `assertNodeWorkspaceDeviceFolderCommand`, which returns early when `deviceFolder` is undefined). This test never creates a device-folder session.
- On the first run, the other failed jobs passed on rerun: `checks-node-changed-compact-small-13-2` (`session-change-event.test.ts`, which this PR does not touch; it passes locally), `checks-ui-e2e (3/9)` (the runner lost its log blob) and `checks-ui (3/3)` (cancelled).
- `openclaw/ci-gate` is red only because of the job above.
